create_Histogram: create a Histogram instance with a given resolution and max_possible value for performance testing
add_Histogram_value: add a numeric value to the Histogram to record it in the appropriate bucket
reset_Histogram: reset the Histogram to clear all recorded data and start fresh
get_Histogram_data: get the Histogram data as a HistogramData protobuf with buckets, min, max, sum, and count
review_Histogram_bucket_for: review the Histogram _bucket_for method that maps values to log-scale bucket indices
